description: Source code implementing path resolution and symlink handling functions for a Git-related project, including realpath resolution, path component parsing, and path prefixing.

methods.name: is_directory
methods.description: Checks if the given path is a directory, considering symlinks.

methods.name: strip_last_component
methods.description: Removes the last component from a path buffer unless it is root.

methods.name: get_next_component
methods.description: Extracts the next path component from remaining path buffer.

methods.name: get_root_part
methods.description: Copies the root part of a path to resolved buffer, canonicalizing slashes.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath_1
methods.description: Resolves a path to its absolute, symlink-free form with options for error handling.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath
methods.description: Returns the absolute, symlink-resolved path, or NULL on error.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath_forgiving
methods.description: Returns the absolute, symlink-resolved path allowing missing trailing components.

methods.name: real_pathdup
methods.description: Duplicates the resolved absolute path as a string.

methods.name: absolute_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path for a given relative path.

methods.name: absolute_pathdup
methods.description: Returns a duplicated string of the absolute path.

methods.name: prefix_filename
methods.description: Prefixes a filename with a given prefix, considering absolute paths.

methods.name: prefix_filename_except_for_dash
methods.description: Prefixes a filename unless it is a dash ('-').

methods.name: strbuf_add_absolute_path
methods.description: Adds an absolute path to a strbuf, resolving relative paths.

methods.name: strbuf_add_real_path
methods.description: Adds a resolved real path to a strbuf.
